comparison.objective: Sort incompatible cleaning chemicals into separate cabinet bays.
comparison.physical_skill: Semantic classification, container grasping, transport, and segregated placement.
comparison.success_condition: Incompatible cleaners occupy separate storage bays. Compatibility rules, spills, and placement tolerances are not provided.
comparison.reason: Hazard-aware sorting of intact containers does not test bimanual hammering, notch fracture, coil retention, or small-fragment recovery.
